spec_match.rationale: Card tag and code comment now say Chrome 150+ (listed in 149), matching feature-lineage.json shippedDesktop 150.

interactive.rationale: New width slider plus the resize corner drive the stage; pills, code annotations and live text follow.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card promises drag-resize, live status badges and the <250px/>500px blue-border OR rule, which is exactly what the page implements.

edge_cases.rationale: Pills and "OBSERVED" annotations read getComputedStyle(card).flexDirection and borderTopColor vs an --accent-blue reference; a warning appears when the rendered style disagrees with the width (pre-150 comma drop).

references.rationale: Fixed 2026-10-04 (weekly hardening): the page now links https://chromestatus.com/feature/6196591858941952, matching its feature index — restoring invariant 3 and the fix-slugs self-heal. Verified by grep against the canonical id on the feature index.

conformance.rationale: The shared feature suite asserts real parse/CSSOM contracts and honestly fails 4 of 5 here.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 via Playwright (NOT chrome-devtools-mcp, unavailable in this cloud session) against a local server, desktop 1280x800 and mobile 360x740 DPR3 touch: slider at 420/200/300/520 -> rule1 row only at >=400, rule2 blue at 196 and 516 only, matching computed styles; zero console errors.

telemetry_health.rationale: Baseline injected telemetry only; the pill/rule state transitions emit no events.

design_system.rationale: Variables throughout; walkthrough and pill 'on' states set background and color together.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled range input with <output>; polite role=status mirrors match state.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No overflow at 360px; the stage caps at ~308px there, so rule 1 (>=400) and the >=500 clause cannot be shown on narrow phones.

summary: Weekly hardening 2026-11-15: rule-match state now derived from rendered styles, added keyboard/touch width slider, live region, and corrected the ship milestone label. Verified in headless Chromium 153 desktop+mobile with zero console errors.

guidanceConsulted.query: external reference links list rel noopener semantics
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep target=_blank external links on rel=noopener; no further guidance matched a plain reference-list addition.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: the restored ChromeStatus links use target=_blank rel=noopener in the page's existing see-also list pattern; change is a reference-list fix only, no layout/control/CSS behavior touched.

guidanceConsulted.query: read computed style to reflect CSS state in JavaScript
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Container queries evaluate the container's content box; let CSS own the layout state.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: readouts read getComputedStyle on the elements the rules style and measure the content box.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Native buttons with programmatic state; announce dynamic state changes non-visually; do not add aria-pressed to a button whose label changes to describe its state.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: aria-pressed on fixed-label toggles, polite role=status summaries.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: There is no container-type for style queries; detect at-rule syntax support some other way than @supports at-rule().
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: support for comma-separated conditions is detected by comparing rendered/CSSOM state with the inputs, not with @supports.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use container-type: inline-size for width-based @container queries.
